description: Source code for validating global initializers in shader programs, including traverser class and validation logic.

classes.name: ValidateGlobalInitializerTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses shader AST nodes to validate global initializers according to shader version and WebGL context.

methods.name: ValidateGlobalInitializerTraverser::visitSymbol
methods.description: Checks if a symbol node in the AST is a valid global initializer based on its qualifier and shader version.

methods.name: ValidateGlobalInitializerTraverser::visitConstantUnion
methods.description: Checks if a constant union node is a valid global initializer based on its qualifier and shader version.

methods.name: ValidateGlobalInitializerTraverser::visitAggregate
methods.description: Disallows function calls in global initializers.

methods.name: ValidateGlobalInitializerTraverser::visitBinary
methods.description: Disallows assignment operations in global initializers.

methods.name: ValidateGlobalInitializerTraverser::visitUnary
methods.description: Disallows assignment operations in unary nodes within global initializers.
